name: Принцип ВНО
northStar: Каждый научный и игровой цикл должен приближать самый слабый столп ВНО к 100%, не ослабляя два других.

loop.name: Возьми открытие
loop.kidMeaning: Найди новое правило, которое мир только что узнал.
requirements: select a real preserved result, including valid negative results
record source evidence, branch/commit provenance and evidence level
state exactly what the code established and what it did not establish
prefer the newest strong result unless an older result has a larger unresolved VNO gap

loop.name: Придумай следующий вопрос
loop.kidMeaning: Спроси: а что будет, если сделать ещё один шаг?
requirements: derive one falsifiable next-step hypothesis from the preserved result
write predicted effect, baseline, failure condition and thresholds before confirmation
target the weakest VNO pillar where possible
include an age-5 sentence that preserves scientific boundaries

loop.name: Преврати в игру
loop.kidMeaning: Подумай, что из этого станет новой интересной штукой в игре.
requirements: evaluate every canonical game system in data/vno-gameplay-systems.json
for each system declare APPLICABLE or NOT_APPLICABLE with a reason
for each applicable system define a concrete player-visible feature
for each applicable system define simple age-5 player copy, code paths, test plan and falsification attack
never activate a runtime domain merely because another domain passed

loop.name: Проверь кодом
loop.kidMeaning: Пусть игра покажет, что новая штука правда работает, а не только красиво звучит.
requirements: use real cause-to-effect tests for every applicable system
compare against a baseline or control
include at least one expected-failure or counterexample test
require regression, performance and production evidence before production activation
reuse docs/SCIENCE_GAMEPLAY_STANDARD.md and lib/science-gameplay-adapter.js rather than creating a parallel runtime

loop.name: Усиль ВНО
loop.kidMeaning: Попроси других проверить, повторить и попробовать всё сломать.
requirements: reproduce from a clean frozen environment
expand unseen seeds and system sizes
use an independent verifier and clean-room reimplementation
run Red Team and adversarial/counterexample tests
compute VNO readiness from the weakest pillar, never an average

loop.name: Улучши саму лабораторию
loop.kidMeaning: Если проверка нашла дырку, сделай так, чтобы следующая проверка была умнее.
requirements: turn every confirmed methodology weakness into a permanent guard or regression test
add new useful failure modes, controls, ablations or independence checks discovered during the cycle
preserve valid failures and counterexamples
do not change scoring rules merely to increase the displayed percentage

loop.name: Начни снова
loop.kidMeaning: Возьми то, что мы узнали, и задай следующий хороший вопрос.
requirements: create the next discovery candidate from the strongest surviving result or most informative failure
carry unresolved blockers forward
increment the cycle record
return to step 1 without weakening production safety or VNO rules

roles.discovery: find or select the scientific result
roles.gameplayTranslator: map the hypothesis to canonical game systems
roles.implementer: build only bounded fail-closed gameplay slices
roles.independentVerifier: verify without relying on implementation internals
roles.redTeamScientist: try to disprove the strongest claim
roles.cleanRoomReplicator: reimplement from specification without copying source logic
roles.navigator: explain player-visible effects in Russian using age-5 language
